mode.description: When to review: mentor — on its own, manual — only on command. A project can turn the autopilot off but cannot turn it on for someone who chose manual.

level.description: The learner level: beginner, intermediate or advanced.

language.description: Advice language: auto — by the VS Code display language.

onLeaveFunction.description: Review when the cursor leaves a changed function.

idleSeconds.description: Review after a typing pause, seconds. 0 — no review on pause.

limits.description: Review limits. A project can only make them stricter: a repository you cloned must not spend your requests.

cooldownMinutes.description: Do not review the same function more often than this, minutes.

maxIssuesPerBlock.description: How many issues to show per function.

minSeverity.description: The mildest severity to show: critical, warning or suggestion (all).

categories.description: false — do not show issues of this category.

silent.description: Test in progress: Adviser is silent in this folder, even on command.

hideSolutions.description: Do not show the ready solution: only the hint and the explanation.

forbidden.description: Words Adviser does not say in this assignment: they are cut from the texts, and a solution containing them is hidden.

readAgentFiles.description: Add files for AI agents to the rules from .adviser/rules.md: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md. Off by default.

ignore.description: Glob patterns of files, from the project root, that Adviser does not send: ["generated/**"].
